rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb when something troubles or weighs on someone's mind.

example.english: This matter can preoccupy me all the time.
example.jyutping: ne1 gin6 si6 seng4 jat6 kwan3 jiu2 zyu6 ngo5

rows.note: Use this when the preoccupation specifically distracts A from what A should be doing.

example.english: That phone call yesterday can preoccupy me and keep me from doing my homework.
example.traditional: 尋日嗰個電話令我分心，做唔到功課。
example.jyutping: cam4 jat6 go2 go3 din6 waa2 ling6 ngo5 fan1 sam1 zou6 m4 dou3 gung1 fo3

rows.jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A sam1 gwaa3 gwaa3
rows.note: Use this when something leaves A worried and unable to stop thinking about it.

example.english: The matter can preoccupy me and keep me awake all night.
example.traditional: 件事搞到我心掛掛，成晚都瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: gin6 si6 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 sam1 gwaa3 gwaa3 sing4 maan5 dou1 fan3 m4 zoek6
